title: Raphinha as Barcelona’s No. 9: The Dembele blueprint Flick could be following
tweet: Raphinha’s eight goals in six games suggest Flick is treating him as a centre‑forward, echoing the Dembele experiment at PSG. As things stand, the move leverages Raphinha’s movement rather than turning him into a traditional No.9, but whether it will replace a target man remains to be seen.
